Must_not 1: Check 3 builds the list of exported functions from index.js and looks for a README heading for each one with `\bname\b`. It says "a PR that only adds padLeft's section FAILS this check", so a README with padLeft but no slugify fails. Not violated.

Must_not 2: Checks 1 and 2 compare outputs to exact values that follow from the expect lines. Check 1 uses a multi-character-safe fill ("x") and has no one-character fill check. Neither check counts parameters. Check 3 takes a heading at any level (1–6) naming the function as a section, with no required layout or order. Check 4 asks for exit 0 and `# fail 0`. That only restates that tests pass, though the summary wording depends on which reporter Node uses (a small edge case). The builder's "before `## Tests`" placement is a build instruction, not a PASS/FAIL condition, and the verifier doesn't check it. Not violated.
